image_description: A medium shot of a three-piece band performing on an elevated stage. From left to right: a guitarist with long hair playing a sunburst electric guitar, a bassist in the center playing a white bass, and a lead singer on the right holding a microphone. The background features a large banner with graffiti-style art and partial text. Stage monitors (wedge speakers) are visible at the bottom edge.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elevated rectangular platform, raised slightly above floor level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subjects are standing on a clearly defined horizontal plane that is elevated relative to the implied audience area, evidenced by the presence of wedge monitors at their feet.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dimensions vary from small intimate platforms to large theatrical stages spanning the full width of a performance hall.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frame is cropped tightly on the performers; the full width and depth of the stage structure are not visible, making dimensional assessment impossible.
The line where the stage floor meets the vertical drop to the audience area is visible behind the stage monitors, defining the proscenium edge.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface is covered with matte black flooring or painted wood.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The floor beneath the musicians' feet appears to be a dark, non-reflective material consistent with standard stage decking or black paint.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Steps or ramps provide access from floor level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No stairs, ramps, or ladders are visible within the current camera frame.
The top of the image cuts off just above the performers' heads; overhead trusses or lighting fixtures are outside the field of view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Constructed from wood or metal decking.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While specific grain is hard to see due to lighting, the structural rigidity and flat surface imply standard wood or metal construction typical for temporary event stages.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface shows scuff marks from performances.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The floor is largely obscured by shadows, cables, and the performers' bodies. No distinct scuff marks are clearly resolvable in the visible patches.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Side and rear may have wings or backdrop supports.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Vertical black poles/trussing are visible behind the musicians, supporting the backdrop banner, which serves as the rear boundary/wing structure.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white lettering on the black backdrop (partially reading 'CR...') exhibits slight irregularity in stroke width and edge sharpness, characteristic of AI-generated text, though it remains legible enough to pass as stylized graffiti.
The fingers on the fretboard of the guitar appear slightly fused and lack distinct knuckle definition, a common minor artifact in AI generation of complex hand-object interactions.
